_purpose: THE definition of 'the final my-agent architecture' for the 20-competition re-run. Every competition names exactly ONE workspace, ONE eval module and ONE search driver. Without this file the re-run is undefined: s3e1 has 13 eval modules and s5e1 has 7, so 're-run with the final architecture' would mean a different thing on every relaunch, making the run neither reproducible nor comparable to the frozen AIDE/NVIDIA yardsticks (2026-08-04 finding).

_rules.eval_module: the canonical evaluator: the plain eval_<comp>.py, or its _v2 where a v2 superseded it. Variant evaluators (eval_ratio_*, eval_featurejoin_*, eval_*_v5_*) are ARM evaluators generated per-run by make_v5_arm and are never the competition's own.
_rules.driver: For a FRESH benchmark run, EVERY competition's driver is skill-generated by copying tree_search/run_template_v3.py (competition-agnostic) and filling it from that run's own Stage 1-3 artifacts; the generated path MUST be recorded into 'driver_actual' before the run counts. The dedicated run_<comp>_v3.py files embed their competition's RECORDED root configs, champion parameters and digit-verify targets -- they exist to REPRODUCE recorded trees and must never seed a fresh run (2026-08-10 round-6: pinning them here would have warm-started each lane from its own recorded answer). They stay pinned below under 'reproduction_driver' for the reproduction use-case only.
_rules.harness: harness_v3 for all competitions (unified blend scoring per 5b2c7af); harness_v2 only as the library harness_v3 delegates to.
_rules.launcher: run_myagent_headless.sh, one competition at a time under the lane lock, run from the isolated root built per _rules.run_root. Its COMPS list is derived from this manifest so the two cannot drift (round 9: the pinned launcher listed 5 of the 20 and then logged 'MY-AGENT LANES COMPLETE').
_rules.extension_tool: There is NO fresh-run extension tool. run_v3_generic.py seeds from the COMMITTED experiments_tree_v3.json and reads llm_proposer_input_<comp>.json (that lane's recorded champion, its evaluated-node scores and a pre-redesign snapshot of experience.md citing itself), so pinning it here handed a fresh lane its own recorded answer twice over (2026-08-10 round-8). It is kept below as 'reproduction_extension_tool' and now refuses to start without an explicit --reproduction flag; both of its inputs are archived by benchmark_infra/archive_workspaces_for_rerun.sh before a fresh run.
_rules.stage2_inputs: Five pinned evaluators do not build their own features: they read a table THIS run's Stage 2 must write into competitions/<comp>/data/. Those tables were previously the RECORDED run's, left in place by the archive and consumed silently (2026-08-10 round-8). The archive now removes them and the evaluators raise through tree_search/stage2_inputs.py naming the artifact and its columns. KAGGLE_REPRO_ARTIFACTS=1 re-enables the recorded artifacts for reproduction only; a benchmark lane never sets it.
_rules.stage2_module_contract: 16 of the 20 pinned evaluators import feature code from competitions/<comp>/scripts/, which is run-GENERATED and therefore archived by the clean slate. That made the dependency invisible: a fresh lane would meet 16 import errors and improvise. The field below states, per competition, the module, and the signature of each callable, that the pinned evaluator expects this run's Stage 2 to provide under that path (extracted mechanically from the evaluator's own imports, 2026-08-10 round-8). Same names, this run's own logic.
_rules.run_root: THE RE-RUN DOES NOT HAPPEN IN THIS REPO. benchmark_infra/build_myagent_run_root.py --write builds an isolated root (default ~/ai_agents/myagent-rerun) by ALLOWLIST: the skill, the knowledge tools, the harness, each competition's pinned evaluator, and each workspace's config.yaml + rules_verdict.json + a data/ symlink to the Kaggle-manifest-verified bench-comps root. Rounds 4-9 all tried to define the clean slate by subtraction inside the repo and round 9 showed the boundary was wrong: the harness auto-injects a memory file keyed on the working directory that names 8 lanes' CV scores, `git show` retrieves every archived file, and documents/, mlflow.db and the repo's own parent all hold per-lane private scores. A fresh working directory gets a fresh (absent) memory directory, no git history, and only what was copied. Verify with verify_clean_slate.py --root <run-root> before launching; benchmark_infra/archive_workspaces_for_rerun.sh is now optional repo hygiene, not the isolation mechanism.
